_note: National focus trees (Focus, scripts/sim/focus.gd). A nation works on one focus at a time; it takes `days`, needs every focus in `requires` done, and then its `effects` apply. Persistent effects (summed in Nation.focus_fx): gdp, industry, food, trade, growth (fractions, as the national programs), diplomacy (points a month), construction (IC a day). One-off effects when it completes: prestige, points (diplomacy points), treasury (GBP millions), war_support, army_size (fraction added to the peacetime army), relation ([[tag, change], ...]), claim ([tags]: a national_claim casus belli for war.cb_years). x and y place the focus on the tree window's grid; ai is how much the AI likes it (a focus with min_aggression is taken only by nations at least that aggressive). Every nation uses the tree of its template plus its own extra foci. A focus with repeatable and max can be taken again after finishing, up to max times in all (Nation.focus_count); its effects apply each time. nations.<TAG>.tree, where present, is the nation's whole tree and replaces its template (the great powers have one of their own, written by tools/make_focus_trees.py).
